О19 as written makes the whole grep ignore letter case, so besides closing the two misses it adds three measured false hits on ordinary text: «private key» in any case and the letters «akia» inside a word («Slovakia»). I followed the decision and named them as limits (a check that is red more often lowers nothing). A narrower form, also measured on the same lines and the sketch tree, keeps every one of the 9 password hits and drops the 3 word false hits: `grep -rnE 'sk-ant-|ghp_|github_pat_|AKIA|PRIVATE KEY|[Pp][Oo][Ss][Tt][Gg][Rr][Ee][Ss]([Qq][Ll])?://[^ :/@]*:([^ @$][^ @]*|\$([^{ @][^ @]*)?)@' app .github/workflows/app.yml --exclude-dir=node_modules` (the sketch tree: no line). Proposal: ORCH decides whether 0118 О19 is narrowed to it before the page texts of R1.2 (an English privacy line could say «private key»).

No Postgres was started for the О18 trial: the launch rule allows a trial server only on 127.0.0.1 port 0, and Postgres cannot listen on port 0.
